How to read this: This is the single Wine & Spirits dashboard — the old Portfolio and Execution Tracker pages both land here. Volume is measured in cases everywhere: the Encompass exports measure volume in a selling size that differs by item (a bottle for some items, a full case for others), and every figure is converted to cases at the product level before anything is added up. Distribution is measured as buying accounts year to date against exactly the same months last year — never a partial year against a full one. Margins are realized figures (case price minus laid-in cost, weighted by cases actually sold) from real invoice transactions; invoice rows carrying no price at all are load-sheet movements rather than sales and are excluded.

Distribution — YTD Buying Accounts

What do these columns mean?
YTD Buyers
Distinct accounts that bought at least one case year to date.
Prior-Yr YTD Buyers
The same count over exactly the same months last year — a like-for-like base, not a full prior year.
Gained / Lost
Accounts buying this year that weren't buying in the prior-year window, and vice versa. Click a row to see them by name.
Trend
Direction of the YTD buyer count against the prior-year YTD count.
Cases
Case volume over the same YTD windows. Nothing here is counted in bottles or eaches — everything is converted to cases at the product level.

Realized Margins by Item — per Case

What do these columns mean?
Avg Case Price
Total $Vol divided by cases sold — the actual net price achieved per case, after discounts.
Avg Laid-In Cost / Case
Weighted average landed cost per case (FOB + freight + duties, as recorded in Encompass).
Margin $/Case
Avg case price minus avg laid-in cost per case.
Margin %
Margin $ divided by $Vol.
